title: Revalidate canonical projected OSD source and shared Book mapping

body:

Genuine global supports and properness prove finite losses, the actual nearest projection produces the one-step chain, and the same recursive run supplies the sharp negative-terminal fixed/variable bounds and positive D/G/T tuning.

The existing15 public proof bodies,5 definitions/1 abbreviation and complete24 canary proofs/7 definitions/1 abbreviation remain byte-identical.
